tasks.label: EARTH: Check Docker and Postgres prerequisites
args:
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s
' 'Docker is unavailable. PostgreSQL, migrations, API database tests and runtime smoke checks are blocked. Install/start Docker Desktop, then rerun.'; exit 1; fi; docker compose up -d; container_id="$(docker compose ps -q postgres)"; if [ -z "$container_id" ] || [ "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$container_id")" != 'healthy' ]; then printf '%s
' 'PostgreSQL is not healthy. Check: docker compose ps'; exit 1; fi; printf '%s
' 'Docker Compose and local PostgreSQL are healthy.'

tasks.label: EARTH: API smoke check
args: if ! curl -fsS http://localhost:3001/health >/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' 'API is unavailable. Start it with: npm run api:dev'; exit 1; fi; info="$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3001/v1/info)" || { printf '%s\n' 'API info endpoint is unavailable. Start it with: npm run api:dev'; exit 1; }; INFO="$info" node -e 'const flags = JSON.parse(process.env.INFO).integrations; const inactive = ["authentication", "nanoChat", "reinforcementLearning", "blockchain", "recyclerNetwork", "digitalProductPassport", "externalApis"]; if (!flags || inactive.some((key) => flags[key] !== false)) { console.error("/v1/info falsely reports an unsupported capability as active"); process.exit(1); } console.log("API health and DEVELOPMENT_ONLY capability flags verified.");'

tasks.label: EARTH: Frontend smoke check
args: if ! curl -fsS http://localhost:5180 >/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' 'Frontend is unavailable. Start it with: npm run dev'; exit 1; fi; printf '%s\n' 'Frontend port 5180 is reachable. This is a reachability check, not browser E2E coverage.'

tasks.label: EARTH: Full verification (Docker required)
dependsOn: EARTH: Check Docker and Postgres prerequisites
